description: Non-material amendment to 20/01923/OUT to amend the description of development to: - Redevelopment of site involving demolition of buildings to provide residential units, together with car parking, cycle parking, plant, hard and soft landscaping, and associated works (Outline Application: Access)., together with amendments to parameter plans approved under Condition 1
decision_conditions: Amended Description of DevelopmentFor the purposes of this decision, the following description of development of planning permission 20/01923/OUT: "Redevelopment of site involving demolition of buildings to provide residential units in buildings up to 6 storeys high, together with car parking, cycle parking, plant, hard and soft landscaping, and associated works (Outline Application: Access)."shall be replaced with the following:"Redevelopment of site involving demolition of buildings to provide residential units, together with car parking, cycle parking, plant, hard and soft landscaping, and associated works (Outline Application: Access)."Amended Condition 1For the purposes of this decision, the following plans that Condition no. 1 of planning permission 20/01923/OUT refers to:CHF-PTE-ZZ-XX-DR-A-10004 Rev. P1 - Access and Circulation PlanCHF-PTE-ZZ-XX-DR-A-10001 Rev. P1 - Development Parcels PlanCHF-PTE-ZZ-XX-DR-A-10002 Rev. P1 - Building Heights and ParameterCHF-PTE-ZZ-XX-DR-A-10003 Rev. P1 - Development Zones and Limits of Deviation Parameters Planshall be replaced with the following:3000 - Access and Circulation Plan Revised3001 - Development Parcels Plan Revised3002 Rev. 01 - Building Heights Parameter Plan Revised3003 - Development Zones and Limits of Deviation Parameters Plan Revised
